title: Fog Hollow
shortDescription: A bowl of fog that does not keep footprints.
longDescription:
The hollow is a bowl in the hill where fog stands thicker than weather. Wool and peat. No silk. No sweetness.
A tall wet shape is here if it still lives. It does not keep footprints. Alder said not to come alone.

fixtures.name: Unkept Ground
fixtures.lookDescription: The floor does not keep footprints. Examine it.
fixtures.examineDescription: Your own paw-marks fade while you watch. The fog is doing work. Three pulses still count under the peat. This is a hunger that learned to walk, not a throne.
